info.title: SpendBehavior Analyzer Backend API
info.description: OpenAPI documentation for the implemented backend MVP endpoints.

get.summary: Root API metadata and health check

200.description: Backend process is responding with API metadata.

post.description: Creates a user and returns the created user. This endpoint does not create a refresh-token session and does not return an access token.

429.description: Too many auth attempts in the rate-limit window.

example.message: Terlalu banyak percobaan. Coba lagi dalam 15 menit.

post.description: Authenticates credentials, creates a refresh-token session, sets the HTTP-only refresh_token cookie, and returns an access token.

429.description: Too many auth attempts in the rate-limit window.

example.message: Terlalu banyak percobaan. Coba lagi dalam 15 menit.

post.description: Uses the HTTP-only refresh_token cookie, rotates the refresh token, and returns a new access token.

Set-Cookie.description: Rotated HTTP-only refresh_token cookie scoped to /api/v1/auth.

401.description: Refresh token is missing or invalid.

post.description: Revokes the active refresh token when present and clears the refresh_token cookie.

patch.description: Updates profile fields for the authenticated user. This route never accepts a user id path parameter.
Changes the password for the authenticated user after validating the old password.

400.description: Validation failed or old password is incorrect.

get.description: Returns system categories plus categories owned by the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a category owned by the authenticated user. Slug is generated by the backend from name.

409.description: Duplicate category for this user and kind.

patch.description: Only user-owned categories can be updated. System categories are read-only.

409.description: Duplicate category for this user and kind.

delete.description: Only user-owned categories can be deleted. Categories used by transactions cannot be deleted.

post.description: Creates a manual income or expense transaction. The selected category must be visible to the user and have the same kind as the transaction type.

422.description: Transaction type does not match category kind.

patch.description: Updates one or more transaction fields. When categoryId or type changes, the category kind must still match the transaction type.

422.description: Transaction type does not match category kind.

post.description: Builds feature vectors from the user's stored expense transactions, calls the ML service unless a cached prediction exists for the same feature vector, persists the result, and returns the prediction.

422.description: ML service rejected the generated feature vector or category/type data is invalid.

503.description: ML service unavailable or timed out.

404.description: No prediction exists for this user.

get.description: Date filters apply to prediction creation time.
Aggregates summary, persona, recent transactions, top categories, weekly trend, weekday/weekend comparison, warnings, money leaks, and insights for the requested period.

FromQuery.name: from
FromQuery.description: Inclusive ISO datetime with timezone offset.

ToQuery.name: to
ToQuery.description: Inclusive ISO datetime with timezone offset.
